description: Calls a scheduled message back before it leaves. Nothing is sent and nothing is lost: it becomes an unsent draft again, with its recipients, text and files, whose draft_id the answer gives (delete_compose_draft throws it away). Refused once the message is already leaving.

scheduled_send_id.description: The id of the scheduled message, as send_email, reply_to_conversation or list_scheduled_sends gives it.

name: cancel_scheduled_send
title: Cancel a scheduled message
